courses.title: Software System Development Project
courses.roles: Supervisor (5 group projects); Examiner (-- group projects)

contents: Contents: Cloud server concepts and technologies including Node.js, NoSQL, MongoDB, MVC, Express.js, EJS, Docker, Oauth, Cloud platform, and Virtual Machine.
outcomes: Outcomes: Students understand and learn cloud server development technologies and complete a cloud server project.

contents: Contents: Concurrent network concepts and programming technologies including livelock, message passing, asynchronous communications, packet switching, Django, Flask, Python, Programming testing and development tools.
outcomes: Outcomes: Students understand, learn and implement a concurrent network server project using Python.

contents: Contents: Fundamental data mining technologies including data preprocessing and machine learning algorithms.
outcomes: Outcomes: Students understand, learn and implement data preparation, processing, and mining processes (RapidMiner).

contents: Contents: Advanced data mining technologies including curve fitting, dimension reduction, kernel trick, regularization, and model assessment techniques.
outcomes: Outcomes: Students understand, learn and implement the learned technologies for solving a real problem.

fyp_projects.description: Developed a scanning enabled personalized calendar (UI, database and function design).
Developed a personalized calendar for travelers (UI, database and function design).
Developed a waste classification and detection system (including data collection, model training, and system integration).
Developed a video content searching and management system (system integrated with AI).
Developed a toilet finder app in Hong Kong (UI, database and function design).
Developed an AI-powered daily event calendar (system integrated with AI).
Developed an AI waste classification application (system integrated with AI).
Developed an Android calendar app tailor-made for students (UI, database and function design).
Developed a computer interaction system for the disabled using EEG headsets and eyetrackers.
Developed a web3 platform for Electronic Health Record Sharing.
Developed a web3 social media platform.
Developed a mobile mobility app that integrates multiple mobility methods in HK.
Developed a UAV-based mountain search and rescue system.
Developed an AI-Powered Personalized Mobility Platform.
Developed a video-based drone behavior detection and monitoring system.
Developed a Web3-Based Approach to Privacy-Preserving Group Communication, File Sharing, and Incentivised Collaboration.
Developed a mobile Augmented (AR) application that uses location-aware to interact 3D content on HKMU campus.
